competing_explanation: Any apparent benefit may come only from added parameters, nonlinear capacity, checkpoint drift, training-budget differences, or seed noise rather than spatially varying demand-protection modulation; the exactly matched global-uniform arm, official baseline, paired seeds, frozen backbone, and fixed final-step evaluation address these alternatives.
controls: A0 official ConvIR-B checkpoint for absolute benefit and harm
A1 identical-parameter global-uniform RDPCM control at the frozen insertion
A2 spatial CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 at the frozen insertion

fixed_factors: A1 global-uniform control uses the exact RDPCM parameter graph and averages post-nonlinearity demand protection and residual fields to 1x1 before broadcast
A2 spatial CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 retains post-nonlinearity fields at native bottleneck resolution
insertion is Decoder[0] output before first decoder upsample and skip fusion
128 input channels, 32 hidden channels, 0.25 tanh output-gate bound, zero output-gate initialization
ConvIR-B parameters frozen; only RDPCM parameters trainable
Haze4K train only; 512 deterministic training groups and 300 clean-reference-disjoint development groups
seeds 3407, 7777, and 20260721 with paired initialization and paired deterministic batches
AdamW learning rate 0.0002, betas 0.9 and 0.999, epsilon 1e-8, zero weight decay, gradient norm cap 1.0
official three-scale L1 plus 0.1 times three-scale complex FFT L1
600 fixed optimizer steps, batch 4, deterministic 256x256 paired crop and horizontal flip
no validation checkpoint selection, early stopping, architecture search, threshold search, or hyperparameter rescue
intervention.matched_budget: Three paired seeds; 600 AdamW steps per arm and seed; batch 4; final-step evaluation only; 41,699 trainable RDPCM parameters per learned arm; frozen official ConvIR-B backbone.

primary_estimand.aggregation: Mean over 300 independent groups with a 10000-replicate paired group bootstrap
primary_estimand.metric: Per clean-reference group PSNR(A2 spatial) minus PSNR(A1 global), averaged within group across the three paired seeds

question: Under identical parameters, insertion, initialization, frozen ConvIR-B backbone, optimizer, schedule, data, seeds, steps, loss, and evidence role, does spatial CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 outperform the same RDPCM branch made global-uniform?

uncertainty.method: 10000-replicate percentile bootstrap over clean-reference groups; the three paired seeds remain coupled and are averaged within each resampled group
